children: Meme coin trader Bonk Guy posted on X that recent gains in his portfolio may make it tempting to follow someone who has made more than $3 million in monthly returns, but investors should fully understand the risks before copying trades. According to Odaily, he said he sometimes opens positions without deep research and may sell at any time for any reason, adding that his purchases should not be seen as an endorsement of any project.

Bonk Guy also said he still sees early opportunities in Robinhood's onchain ecosystem and will continue holding projects he likes and participating in the ecosystem. He added that no coin rises forever and that every position will eventually be sold.

title: Bonk Guy Warns Investors Not to Blindly Copy His Meme Coin Trades
